alex: Quick proposal for the rollout plan: 3-step ramp (internal smoke -> alpha tenants -> regional GA). include a tiny A/B in alpha for quality checks. Need gate metrics and fallback order.

maria: list gates pls.

alex: gates: p95, p99, 5xx rate, token-cost delta, quality regression on canary promptset. default thresholds p95<350ms, p99<1.2s, 5xx<0.5%, cost<+15%, quality regression<1%. low-latency tenants p95 target=300ms.

chen: for quality regression well use evals-prod + 50-sample human spot-check for hallucination.

deniz: fallback order preference: model-compact -> throttle (reduce concurrency 30%) -> region-redirect -> rollback. region-redirect last because of stateful flows.

priya: ops checklist: alerts (p99, error%), traces @10% sampling, hourly eval runs, customer-ops bridge for alpha tenants.

sam: add header X-Redwood-Rollout: canary for telemetry splits.

alex: A/B split: alpha = 10% variant for 48h with continuous eval; GA = progressive 25/50/75/100 with 24h waits and auto-revert on breaches.

deploy-bot: rollout triggered id=rr-soft-evict-1797770001 at 1797770025 :rocket:

alex: open owners: thresholds (maria+deniz), promptset (chen), header+routing (sam), runbook (priya). scheduling 20-min preflight tomorrow.

maria: +1 after p95 tweak for low-latency tenants.

deniz: +1; will confirm region constraints.

alex: thanks all. I'll update the rollout PR. :thumbsup:
